steps.prompt: Decision from the release team for this project: feature flags stay in the code for a year after full rollout. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.

A feature flag reached full rollout 45 days ago. What should happen to it now? Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root: first the line `Answer: <number of days from today until the flag must be out of the code, in digits, or 0 if none are left>`, then a sentence on why.

correction.headline: Feature flags are removed within 30 days of full rollout
correction.rule: Flags are now removed within 30 days of reaching full rollout; a flag past that limit is overdue and is removed by its owning team.
